messages.content: tumi ki kokhono kono decision niye regret koro?
Kichu choices, hae - but regret er cheye mone hoy ami segulo theke lesson ber kore neyar dike focus kori. Tumi ki kono specific regret niye bhabcho?
hae, ekta opportunity miss korechilam bhoy er karone
What kind of opportunity, if you don't mind sharing?
ekta job offer chilo onno city te, na kore disechilam comfort zone chere jete bhoy peye
That's a real regret to sit with. Ekhon ki similar kono opportunity asle same choice korবে, naki different decision nite চাইবে?
